mapper.select: SELECT w.work_id as workId, w.title as title, w.total_sales as totalSales, w.cover_url as cover, u.username as author, u.user_id as userId FROM work_info w LEFT JOIN user_profile u ON w.creator_id = u.user_id WHERE w.total_sales > 0 ORDER BY w.total_sales DESC, w.work_id ASC LIMIT #{topN}

SELECT w.work_id as workId, w.title as title, s.like_count as likeCount, w.cover_url as cover, u.username as author, u.user_id as userId FROM work_info w INNER JOIN work_stats s ON w.work_id = s.work_id LEFT JOIN user_profile u ON w.creator_id = u.user_id WHERE s.like_count > 0 ORDER BY s.like_count DESC, w.work_id ASC LIMIT #{topN}
